app_type: Hybrid Fullstack SaaS Video Caption Editor
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: The application must feel like a professional tactical command center for video editing. Prioritize density, data correlation, and scanability. The interface should heavily rely on a dark structural grayscale to keep the video content as the hero. Break standard SaaS conventions by using high-contrast borders and deep obsidian surfaces rather than soft generic shadows.

headings.description: Used for app headers, modal titles, and major section titles. Never use Inter for headings.

body.description: Used for transcription text, subtitles, timeline labels, and general UI.

mono.description: Used for timecodes, usage limits (e.g., '00:00:45'), and technical readouts.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Hierarchy gap must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Timecodes must be monospaced for visual alignment.
Use 'tracking-[0.2em]' for small labels and overlines.

background.description: Deep obsidian anchor for high-contrast tactical feel.

primary.description: Volt Blue for the primary CTA, playhead, and selected word state.

accents.description: Colors used for highlighting 'important' words and preset themes.

editor_layout.structure: Grid cols-12. Left sidebar for tools/themes (col-span-3), Center Preview (col-span-6), Right Transcript (col-span-3). Bottom full-width timeline.
editor_layout.spacing: Tight padding (p-4 or p-6) within panels, gap-4 between panels. Container MUST not have centered text alignment.

timeline.structure: Horizontal scrollable container with absolute positioned playhead. Timeline tracks must use 'h-full' to ensure they stretch. Include a visible audio waveform track.
timeline.spacing: Compact, 1px gaps between adjacent word blocks to maintain timing.

component_instructions.timeline_word_block: Custom component. Represents spoken words. Active/playing state needs Volt Blue highlight. Must include 'data-testid' like 'word-block-[index]'.
component_instructions.video_player: Custom HTML5 video wrapper. Overlay a relative/absolute positioned div for the live caption preview.
component_instructions.theme_selector: Shadcn Tabs or Toggle Group for Viral, Cinematic, Minimal, Podcast themes. Each should have visual cues (small dot of accent color).
component_instructions.paywall_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Glassmorphism overlay. Display pricing tiers: Free (1x 45s), ₹69 One-off (45s), ₹399 Basic Plan (10x 60s). Include usage tracking progress bar.
component_instructions.upload_zone: Large dashed border area, custom HTML/Tailwind. Highlight Volt Blue on drag-over.
component_instructions.shadcn_overrides: Do not build complex components (Dialogs, Selects) from scratch. Heavily customize Shadcn components to match the tactical dark theme.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactical Minimalism'. Replace soft shadows with 1px solid borders (#27272A). Flat backgrounds for panels.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For Sticky Header / Modals: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 with 1px bottom/inner border. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic full-screen gradients. Use text-gradients only for 'Viral' and 'Cinematic' caption rendering on the video.

motion.hover_states: Buttons lift (-translate-y-px). Always explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
motion.playback_playhead: Smooth horizontal translation using 'transform: translateX()'. Do NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.word_highlight: Scale up slightly (scale-105) when word is spoken during playback preview.

profile_avatar.description: User profile thumbnail in the top right nav.

workspace_bg.description: Used as a very low opacity (10-20%) background in the initial 'Empty State / Upload' screen to avoid a dead black screen.

icons.instruction: Run 'yarn add @phosphor-icons/react'. Use Phosphor icons for a dense, professional tech-heavy look.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Captions over video MUST have a text-shadow or dark scrim behind them to ensure readability.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings with HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-video-btn', data-testid='timeline-track').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). This breaks transforms. Use specific transition properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (Timeline above panels).
Use Phosphor icons. NEVER use AI emoji characters.
Ensure the application strictly follows a dark theme.
Use predefined image URLs, do not use placeholder text.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' components for the main editor grid; use custom HTML divs for precise dense spacing and overlapping.
All interactive elements must have hover, active, and focus states.
Always set explicit padding on containers with borders to prevent text collision.
